attributes.action: Call for an immediate snap general election
attributes.additional_details:
The new PM Andy Burnham has entered number 10 "through the back door" with the support of only 35,000 votes of one constituency that is Makerfield and does not represent the majority of the people in the UK. His recent attempts in changes/implementation of ideas and policies is not following the mandate the people voted for in the 2024. 
Therefore the people should have a voice into whether they accept Andy Burnham as the PM or Deny him as one in line with the British democracy system.
attributes.background: A call for an immediate snap general election is the request of the majority of people in the UK in order to accept or deny the new PM Andy Burnham into number 10 in regards to Labours 2024 mandate/manifesto pledges.
